   3 │ ## What happens now
   4 │ When I give my command more than one name for the help option, the names come back in
   5 │ a mixed-up order instead of the order I wrote them. If I write the names as short one
   6 │ first and long one second, the program may show them the other way around. The order

   8 │ 
   9 │ ## What should happen
  10 │ The help option names should stay in the same order I wrote them. If I write the same
  11 │ name twice, only the first one should be kept. Names that another option already uses
  12 │ should still be left out. I should be able to set the names and then see them exactly
  13 │ as I arranged them.
  14 │ 
  15 │ ## About this project
  16 │ This project is a tool for people who build command-line programs in Python. It takes
  17 │ care of reading the options a user types, printing the help text, and showing errors.
  18 │ People use it so they do not have to write all of that themselves.
  19 │ 
  20 │ ## Problem this solves
  21 │ People who pick their own short and long names for the help option get them back in a
  22 │ random order, so the help text can look wrong and confuse the people using their
  23 │ program. This matters most when a name they chose clashes with another option and the
  24 │ leftover names come out shuffled.
  25 │ 
  26 │ ## What changed
  27 │ The help option names now keep the order in which they were given. Names that appear
  28 │ more than once are trimmed so the first one stays. Names that another option already
  29 │ uses are still removed. Before, the order was lost; now it is kept.
  30 │ 
  31 │ ## Impact
  32 │ Ease of use and correctness.
  33 │ 
  34 │ ## User experience
  35 │ Before: I set the help names as the short one first and the long one second, and the
  36 │ program sometimes shows them swapped. After: I set the same two names and they show up
  37 │ exactly in that order every time.

I'll start by reading the ticket and checking the workspace changes.I have read the ticket and inspected the change. Here is my plan for the feedback report.

**What I read.** The ticket at `/megabit/ticket.md` asks that the automatic help option's names keep the order they were given in `help_option_names`, that duplicates be removed keeping the first occurrence, and that names already used by another option still be dropped — the hints point at `/workspace/src/click/core.py`, `/workspace/tests/test_commands.py`, and `/workspace/CHANGES.md`.

**The diff.** `git diff HEAD --name-only` returns exactly two files: `CHANGES.md` and `src/click/core.py`.
